blocks.text: CALAPAN CITY, Oriental Mindoro — Environmental and human rights advocates on Monday urged the Marcos administration to adopt a national industrial policy and enact an alternative minerals management law, warning that current mining policies could promote destructive extraction without ensuring Filipinos benefit from mineral resources. At the Oct. 26 launch of Mining Hell Week, Alyansa Tigil Mina (ATM) national coordinator Jaybee Garganera criticized the government’s move toward an agreement on Pax Silica and implementation of Executive Order No. 122 on critical minerals, saying the country needed a clear policy to ensure its mineral resources support national industrialization. “The Philippines must ensure […]...
